name: EOSVegas
rootCause: The attacker launched continuously attacks and profit from the EOSVegas. The analysis found that the attack mean used by the attacker was transaction congestion attack. The account is extremely active. It just attacked the quiz game EOS Cube and its related account has been marked as high risk.
